critique: The monumental Adinkra-patterned cloth, lone white-robed figure, and broad sunlit ground deliver bold primary colour, high-key clarity, and an excellent tension between visual abundance and compositional spareness. The added cobalt, yellow, emerald, and vermilion SVG bands needlessly compete with the textile’s own geometry—and the tiny guinea pig reads as an arbitrary joke—so removing both would let the loom-in-progress idea remain singular and legible.
